question: Which single remaining bounded experiment should be examined next to distinguish the most important unresolved hypothesis, given the verified M1-M3 evidence? Choose only from the listed experiments or abstain; do not execute anything.

options.description: Inline the gamma-flow-to-cycle-double-cover seam while preserving the intended mathematics. This tests whether dependency topology can change even when the mathematical content is preserved, helping separate graph-shape evidence from semantic evidence.

Remove the DecidableEq E assumption from the theorem surface and test whether Lean can still elaborate. Survival would make redundant-formal-assumption a candidate hypothesis and require checking whether classical reasoning or instance synthesis silently supplies what was removed.

Keep the frozen Lean source unchanged but corrupt only the Repository Search dependency projection by removing the Jaeger-Kilpatrick edge. This hypothesis probe tests whether the dependency observer can contradict a bad projection independently of Lean.

Keep the frozen Lean source unchanged but corrupt only the Repository Search projection by removing the gamma-flow bridge edge. This hypothesis probe tests a second dependency-surface falsifier without changing the formal theorem.
Do not choose a next bounded experiment because the supplied verified state is insufficient to distinguish which remaining hypothesis is most informative.
